name: 97209 · Portland, OR
findings: ZIP 97209 (Portland) has 191 nonprofit organizations. 94 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 79 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (10% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97209 (Portland) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 97209 (Portland) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 6.0 times the typical level).
